descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-11 Course Timeline · S26 A pre-round that was never finished, then a visit after a skipped day (live AI)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 One entry per completed visit, correctly dated, in chronological order, never duplicated. (UAT TC-11; TFA-92589 AC 3)
  • U2 A day the patient was not seen is legitimately absent: no entry and no filler line for it. (UAT TC-11; TFA-92589 description 2)
  • T2 A new timeline entry is created automatically on every completed note, generated from that day's finished note. (TFA-92589 AC 2; TFA-92589 description 1)
  • U4 Nursing Home: entries are keyed by visit number and labelled 'Visit N – date'. (UAT TC-11; TFA-92589 AC 5)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Seeded with server-clock labels. Hospital {hospitalPatient}: '{day-1}: Pre-rounded. ⏳ Encounter pending.' (yesterday's pre-round, no note). Nursing Home {snfResident}: 'Visit 1 · {day-2}: Pre-rounded.' (no note), and nothing on {day-1}

When In each context, run today's visit: Pre-Round Save Note, then Encounter and Generate Note & Finish; then look at the timeline

Then Hospital: exactly one card for today, carrying the encounter's facts; what yesterday's never-finished line shows as is recorded (Q12). Nursing Home: exactly one line dated today and none dated {day-1} (the skipped day stays absent, no filler); …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs, scoped to the Course Timeline / Visit Timeline, plus the post-run storageCheck. Judged: one line for today in each context, an encounter fact in it, no 'Encounter done', and (NH) no line dated {day-1}: this is the only automated U2 check that does a visit after a skipped day. …

Where it ran: dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S26 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-11.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on dev; Source: dev.
